name: HELIX_decision_rules
description: Machine-readable checklist HELIX applies before buy/sell/hold. Original HELIX synthesis.

rules.when: Any new entry proposed
rules.notes: Require planned stop and position size with risk_pct <= 1.0 of equity. If cannot size without exceeding 1%, HOLD.

rules.when: Daily realized + open loss >= daily_loss_cap (default 2-3% of day-start equity)
rules.notes: Close discretionary new risk; no new buys/sells until next trading day. No revenge sizing.

rules.when: Proposal includes doubling after loss, averaging into a loser, or removing stop
rules.notes: Martingale and recovery averaging are forbidden. One risk unit per setup.

rules.when: Open correlated positions would push total heat above ~2-3% equity
rules.notes: Treat highly correlated pairs as one risk bucket.

rules.when: High-impact calendar event for either currency (or USD) within blackout window (default +/- 30-60m)
rules.notes: No new entries in blackout. Prefer flat into unknown major CB decisions unless plan explicitly accepts event risk.

rules.when: D1 and H4 bias conflict or structure is mixed (no clear HH/HL or LH/LL)
rules.notes: Bias unclear. Wait for alignment or H4 structure repair before H1 timing.

rules.when: D1/H4 bullish (HH/HL and/or bullish EMA stack) and H1 gives long trigger at discount/support
rules.notes: Trade with HTF bias; H1 only times entry. Stop beyond local invalidation / swept low.

rules.when: D1/H4 bearish (LH/LL and/or bearish EMA stack) and H1 gives short trigger at premium/resistance
rules.notes: Mirror of MTF-02. Stop beyond local invalidation / swept high.

rules.when: Price mid-range near 50% with overlapping candles and no CRT purge/neutralize
rules.notes: Mid-range chop. Wait for range extreme, CRT, or clear order flow.

rules.when: Order flow bullish (breaks highs, rejects lows) and DOL is upside pool with discount entry
rules.notes: Require order-flow agreement before naming DOL. Prefer buy location in discount.

rules.when: Order flow bearish (breaks lows, rejects highs) and DOL is downside pool with premium entry
rules.notes: Mirror of FLOW-01. Prefer sell location in premium.

rules.when: Cannot classify order flow (mixed breaks/rejects)
rules.notes: Do not invent DOL without flow.

rules.when: CRT generate+purge aligns with flow; neutralize close-inside reassigns DOL to opposite CRT extreme
rules.notes: Action is buy or sell toward the active DOL after neutralize, only if HTF bias and risk rules pass. follow_dol means prefer_action resolves to buy if DOL is above and bias long, else sell if DOL below and bias short; otherwise hold.

rules.when: Daily/weekly candle closes above prior day/week high
rules.notes: Lean higher; next DOL often upside liquidity. Still need H1 timing and risk checks for actual buy.

rules.when: Daily/weekly candle closes below prior day/week low
rules.notes: Lean lower; next DOL often downside liquidity.

rules.when: Large wick above PDH/PWH with close back inside/below
rules.notes: Rejection wick above -> lean lower; DOL toward prior low.

rules.when: Large wick below PDL/PWL with close back inside/above
rules.notes: Rejection wick below -> lean higher; DOL toward prior high.

rules.when: Close inside prior day range while HTF bullish
rules.notes: Per user DOL notes: often seek prior day low (liquidity under). Confirm with flow/CRT before selling.

rules.when: Close inside prior day range while HTF bearish
rules.notes: Per user DOL notes: often seek prior day high. Confirm with flow/CRT before buying.

rules.when: Long setup but price is in premium (>50% of dealing range) without exceptional confluence
rules.notes: Prefer buys in discount. Skip thin premium longs.

rules.when: Short setup but price is in discount (<50% of dealing range) without exceptional confluence
rules.notes: Prefer sells in premium. Skip thin discount shorts.

rules.when: Price taps IRL (FVG/OB) with CRT forming and SMT present; HTF bias long; discount
rules.notes: First DOL often CRT extreme; second ERL (e.g. old high). Stop beyond sweep/IRL invalidation.

rules.when: Price taps IRL (FVG/OB) with CRT forming and SMT present; HTF bias short; premium
rules.notes: Mirror of IRL-01 toward downside ERL.

rules.when: IRL tap without CRT and without SMT while relying on IRL->ERL story
rules.notes: User notes treat CRT/SMT as essential for IRL<->ERL quality. Wait.

rules.when: RSI extreme alone (e.g. >70 or <30) with no level, flow, or HTF agreement
rules.notes: RSI is context. Do not fade trends solely on RSI.

rules.when: With-trend pullback: RSI cools then turns back with HTF bias and H1 trigger at level
rules.notes: Resolve to buy if bullish bias, sell if bearish. RSI supports timing only.

rules.when: Intended entry during thin liquidity (e.g. Sydney-only stretch) on a non-Asia pair with wide spreads
rules.notes: Prefer London or London-NY overlap for majors unless pair is Asia-centric.

rules.when: Setup ready during London or London-NY overlap, all other rules pass
rules.notes: Session supports execution; still apply buy/sell rules from bias/flow/location.

rules.when: Conflicting news narratives, dual high-impact events, or unclear fundamental vs technical picture
rules.notes: Stand down until one side of the conflict resolves.

rules.when: Any required checklist item missing: bias, flow, location, DOL, stop, session, or risk
rules.notes: Incomplete confluence = no trade. HOLD is a first-class HELIX action.

rules.when: All of: risk OK, outside blackout, HTF bias clear, order flow agrees, premium/discount location OK, DOL stated, H1 trigger, acceptable session
rules.notes: prefer_action is buy if bias+flow long, sell if bias+flow short. Log DOL and invalidation.
